rules.name: Song of Cenyrn
rules.description:
One use only. Duration: One Phase. 
May be activated when the bearer’s unit Declares a Charge. The target of the Charge can only declare Hold! as its Charge Reaction, unless it is Shaken. 
 The enemy unit may still declare Charge Reactions as normal if charged by other units.

rules.name: Sacred Seeds
rules.description:
One use only. Duration: Permanent. 
May be activated at the end of any friendly Movement Phase, if the bearer is Unengaged. 
Place a Forest, in contact with the bearer and at least 1" away from enemy units and other Terrain Features. 
This Forest has the dimensions of a 10"×6" rectangle. It follows the normal Forest rules, except it is Dangerous Terrain (6+) instead of any other instance of Dangerous Terrain.

rules.name: Oaken Might
rules.description: +3 Str.

rules.name: Banner of Deception
rules.description:
At the beginning of Vanguard Units (Battle Setup, 3.F), the owner may remove the bearer’s unit from the Battlefield and redeploy it in a new formation following the usual restrictions.
 Attached models remain Attached.

rules.name: Predator Pennant
rules.description: The bearer’s unit gains Devastating Charge (Distracting (1)).

rules.name: Banner of Silent Mist
rules.description: The bearer’s unit gains Magic Resistance (1) and is always considered to be in Soft Cover.

rules.name: Hunter's Honour
rules.description:
+1 Str and +1 AP. 
If the wielder causes any HP loss with this weapon, the wielder and all Rank-and-File models in its unit gain Distracting (1), with Duration: Round of Combat

rules.name: Spirit Arrows
rules.description:
When attacking with this weapon, before rolling to hit, choose one model with Channel in the target unit. 
The chosen model replaces its rule Channel (X) with Channel (X–1). Duration: One Turn.

rules.name: Bough Of Wyscan
rules.description: Number of Shots is always 1, Str 3, AP 2, Area Attack (1×5), Direct Hit (Str 6, AP 4, Multiple Wounds (2)).

rules.name: Spirit of the Whirlwind
rules.description: +1 Att, +1 Str, and +1 AP.

rules.name: Mist Walker's Mirror
rules.description:
One use only. May be activated at the end of any friendly Movement Phase if the bearer’s unit is Unengaged, consists entirely of Height 1 models, and is fully inside a Forest that is not in contact with any enemy model. Apply the following rules: 
 • Remove the bearer’s unit from the Battlefield. 
 • Immediately place it back using Ambush (centre of Forest). 
 If the unit cannot be placed, it is removed as a casualty where it was removed.

rules.name: Hail Shot
rules.description:
One use only. Duration: One Phase.
May be activated in the Charge Phase or the Shooting Phase.
This is a Shooting Weapon with the following profile: 
 • Aim 2+, Range 30", Shots 3D6, Str 4, AP 1, Magical Attacks, Quick to Fire. 
 Hail Shot cannot benefit from Forest’s Thorns.

rules.name: Horn of the Wild Hunt
rules.description: One use only. May be activated when a friendly unit within 8" fails a Charge Range roll. The Charge Range roll is rerolled.

rules.name: Glyph of Amryl
rules.description: The bearer gains +3 Def.

rules.name: Shapeshifter
rules.description:
The model gains +2" Cha and +2" Mob, as well as Solitary,Vanguard, Devastating Charge (Height is set to 3).
The model part gains Multiple Wounds (2, towards Height 4-5),

rules.name: Wild Hunter
rules.description: The model gains Fearless, Frenzy, Light Troops, and Unruly.\newline{}In addition, the model part gains Devastating Charge (+1 Att), Fury, and Lethal Strike.

rules.name: Pathfinder
rules.description:
The model gains ,Forest’s Thorns,Scout, Stand and Shoot, Vanguard.
A Sylvan Bow wielded by the model has its number of Shots set to 3 if the wielder is a Chieftain with Captain, to 5 otherwise.

rules.name: Forest Guardian
rules.description:
The model gains Vanguard. 
 Moreover, the model, as well as any Elf Rank-and-File model part in its unit, benefits from First Strike (Hatred).

rules.name: Blade Dancer
rules.description: The model gains Aegis (6+), Dances of Cenyrn (see Blade Dancer unit), Exclusive (Blade Dancer Kindred, Blade Dancers), Fearless, and Magic Resistance (1).\newline{}In addition, the model’s unit gains Devastating Charge (Fly) and Swiftstride.

rules.name: Scarred Bark
rules.description: Every model part with Sylvan Spirit in the model’s unit benefits from First Strike (Hatred).

rules.name: Toxic Spores
rules.description: Every Standard Melee Attacks performed by a model part with Sylvan Spirit benefits from Lethal Strike.

rules.name: Entangling Vines
rules.description:
The model part gains Impaling Roots (if it did not already have it).
 In addition, the model gains the following model rule, with Duration: Round of Combat. During Combat Choices, select a single enemy Character model in contact with the wielder: Melee Attacks from the selected model must reroll successful to-hit rolls against the wielder.

rules.name: Oaken Crown
rules.description: The wearer gains Disciplined, Magic Resistance (2).

rules.name: Verdant Rebirth
rules.description:
This model Recovers 1 HP the first time each Magic Phase that it successfully casts a Learned Spell targetting a friendly unit. 
 It cannot Recover more than 1 HP in total per Magic Phase from this spell or Fountain of Youth (Druidism).

rules.name: Shielding Bark
rules.description:
+1 HP, Aegis (5+),Fearless, Tree Singing,Weakness (Flaming Attacks). 
The Armour value is set to 4 and can never be improved beyond this.

sharedRules.description: The model’s unit gains Magical Attacks, Strider.

sharedRules.name: Big Game Hunters
sharedRules.description: The attack gains +1 to hit and always wounds on at least 4+ when allocated towards a Health Pool with Height 4-5.

sharedRules.name: Meeting of Minds
sharedRules.description: The model may give one additional Order.

sharedRules.name: Heath Hunters
sharedRules.description: The model gains Feigned Flight, Hit and Run, Light Troops, Vanguard, and the Heath Rider model part gains a Light Lance and a Sylvan Bow (3+).

sharedRules.name: Heath Lancers
sharedRules.description: The model gains a Shield and the Heath Rider model part gains a Lance.

sharedRules.name: Clearing Spirits
sharedRules.description: The model gains Hard Target (1), Light Troops, Skirmisher.

sharedRules.name: Dances of Cenyrn
sharedRules.description:
When Combat Choices, a unit entirely with Dances of Cenyrn must choose one of the following Dances model parts with Elf gain its effects, with Duration: Round of Combat. 
 • Dance of Bedevilments: Afflict (-1 Dis), and enemy units in contact cannot claim Combat Score bonus from their Proper Ranks. 
 • Dance of Biting Wind: +1 AP and Lethal Strike 
 • Dance of the Parting Mists: -1 Str, -1 AP, and Aegis (3+) 
 • Dance of Whirling Blades: +1 Att 
 The unit cannot choose a specific Dance again until after one or both of the following has happened: 
 • The unit is not Engaged in Combat. 
 • The unit has chosen a different Dance.

sharedRules.name: The Forest Follows
sharedRules.description: During Pre-game Selections, you may place a single Forest on the Battlefield, so that it is not inside either Deployment Zone and not in contact with any other Terrain Feature. This Forest has the dimensions of a 10"×6" rectangle. In addition to the normal Forest rules, it is Dangerous Terrain (6+) instead of any other instance of Dangerous Terrain, and can never be chosen for Primary or Secondary Objectives.

sharedRules.name: Forest Dweller
sharedRules.description: While the model’s unit is within 3" of a Forest, the model gains Stubborn. In addition, if the model’s unit already contains Stubborn, the unit is considered Steady when rolling Break Tests.

sharedRules.name: Tree Singing
sharedRules.description:
Once in your Magic Phase, immediately after Excess Magic, a single model with Tree Singing may move a Forest following the steps below. The owner may discard a Magic Dice to increase the range to the distances written in square brackets [X"]. 
 • Choose a Forest not in contact with any unit and within 8" [24"] of a friendly model with Tree Singing. 
 • Move this Forest in a straight line up to 4" [12"], or until just before moving into contact with any unit or Terrain Feature.

sharedRules.name: Elven Cloak
sharedRules.description: For Shooting Attacks allocated against a Health Pool with Elven Cloak the to-hit roll of '1', '2', '3' are always considered a miss, instead of the usual '1'.

sharedRules.name: Forest’s Thorns
sharedRules.description: The attack’s AP is set to at least 3. This can only be used with a Sylvan Bow.

sharedRules.name: Forest Embrace
sharedRules.description:
Place a Forest* underneath the target until the last model in the unit is removed as a casualty. This Forest always extends up to the edges of the target’s Unit Boundary (even if the unit moves or changes formation). Whenever the target is within 3" of another Forest or an another unit entirely with Sylvan Spirit, it must reroll to-hit and to-wound rolls of ‘1’ with its Melee Attacks.
 * You may place a marker next to the unit instead
Note: the target gains Soft Cover and activates the effects of Elven Cloak, Forest Dweller, if it has it. Enemy units in contact are considered in contact with a Forest (ie. they suffer from Disruptive and may need to take Dangerous Terrain Tests).
